review: DRAFT, NOT ACCEPTED, NOT YET COMPILABLE: independently reviewed original 5Zone_IdealLoadsAirSystems_ReturnPlenum.idf SHA256 1fc3cae54a39c004522db324ab7f172ce123d146e9fd63548393d4921f1a9786 and closed real-ideal-loads-25-1-20260907T162941.603417700/eplusout.sql SHA256 c43c777904b93b313617f8dcc8e40388bec4b3ac3549e4279d15f13c5019849d; no candidate-derived numeric expectations are included. The original has six Zones with Zone and SQL list multipliers one: SPACE1-1 through SPACE5-1 each has one ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem and PLENUM-1 is the shared AirLoopHVAC:ReturnPlenum. Actual Zone equipment lists and plenum inlet/outlet nodes establish those five served owners; there is no AirLoopHVAC main loop, fan, coil, pump or plant. Ideal Loads output keys ZONE 1 IDEAL LOADS through ZONE 5 IDEAL LOADS are equipment names, not Zone-name aliases. Each Ideal Loads unit connects to its corresponding SPACE and the common return plenum; the plenum is not a sixth conditioned equipment owner. Actual Zone Air System Sensible Cooling/Heating Energy Monthly/J observations exist for all six Zones and are the declared sensible authority, including nonzero plenum heating. Ideal Loads Zone/Supply sensible, latent and total observations differ from that authority and from one another; they are not added, relabelled as equal aliases or substituted for the selected sensible load. The ideal-specific availability declarations prove reported context only. People, Lights, ElectricEquipment and ZoneInfiltration:DesignFlowRate each have exactly five original SPACE owners and five corresponding SQL identities. Internal totals, storage, surface balance and interzone air balance report all six Zones. Subtracting a component outside its declared membership contributes zero only to a derived subtraction, never a fabricated source observation. Outdoor-air balance minus infiltration applies only to the five SPACE owners; PLENUM-1 has no infiltration object/identity and its outdoor-air transfer remains outdoor.unsplit. The 46 reported heat-transfer surfaces correspond to forty original BuildingSurface:Detailed and six FenestrationSurface:Detailed objects. All Zone/base/boundary references resolve; thirteen interzone pairs are reciprocal, there are no InternalMass self-boundaries, and SQL Roof includes the five interzone ceilings. The reviewed surface_class_boundary/v1 mapping and sign are unchanged. All 513 Monthly SQL dictionary identities have twelve finite non-warmup Weather-environment observations in 2017 with twelve distinct TimeIndex/month values and no duplicate name/key/unit/meter/frequency identities. Runtime annualization replaces the original two one-day RunPeriods with fixed 2017 January 1 through December 31, retaining timestep four and equipment, weather and schedules. SQL contains 8760 hourly and twelve monthly Weather records; severe/fatal counts are zero. Three site declarations select actual Monthly/J Electricity:Facility, InteriorLights:Electricity and InteriorEquipment:Electricity meters; the two directUses select actual Monthly/J Zone Lights Electricity Energy and Zone Electric Equipment Electricity Energy for exactly the five SPACE owners. Original custom electricity meters duplicate those quantities and are not added. Absence of requested Cooling:Electricity and Heating:Electricity ReportData dictionaries is not proof of absent modeled cooling/heating consumption: original SQL TabularDataWithStrings independently reports AnnualBuildingUtilityPerformanceSummary / Entire Facility / End Uses / Cooling / District Cooling / kWh and Heating / District Heating Water / kWh, with matching Total End Uses carrier cells. Four additional site.tabular declarations bind exactly those annual end-use and Total End Uses carrier cells, with reported kWh and two decimal places, without copying their values. These selectors require the forthcoming explicitly annual proof/frame integration; services=[] is only a non-compilable draft placeholder, not a no-consumption declaration. The annual table must not be synthesized into Monthly observations. SourceEnergyEndUseComponentsSummary and DemandEndUseComponentsSummary are distinct source-energy and peak-demand reports, not site-energy substitutes. No district Steam, gas, monthly HVAC site, fan/pump pool, fake zero or COP source is invented. The forty availability groups are restricted to the actual executed Monthly output plan, with exact observed units and meter flags; unrequested Small Office equipment/plant meter groups are not copied. All shared precision and family arithmetic declarations are unchanged. Annual tabular service/ratio/source integration, strict compilation and complete candidate comparison remain pending; no expected manifest or fixture acceptance is approved.
